title: The Ship You Cannot Reach

hints.text: Look above the New Orleans Square roofs and pretend you are standing in a busy port.
The ship is not on the river in front of you. Only part of it appears above the buildings.
Find the sailing-ship masts and sails peeking over the New Orleans Square roofline.

revealDescription: The rooftop masts and sails create the illusion that a tall ship is docked just beyond the buildings, extending the port-city story beyond the visible streets.
